name: omegas-dev
description: Open-source viewer and transfer tool for personal Claude Code and Codex configs
author: Noureddin Bakir

scripts.check: node --check bin/omegas-dev.js && node --check src/*.js && node --check src/cli/*.js && node --check src/hosted/*.js && node --check src/core/adapters/*.js && node --check src/core/bundle/*.js && node --check src/core/compat/*.js && node --check src/core/engine/*.js && node --check src/core/formats/*.js && node --check src/core/fsx/*.js && node --check src/core/model/*.js && node --check src/core/policy/*.js && node --check src/core/redact/*.js
scripts.gates: npm run gate:purity && npm run gate:secrets && npm run gate:network && npm run gate:adversarial && npm run gate:noop && npm run gate:compat && npm run gate:cutover && npm run gate:release
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run check && npm run gates
